launcher.title: Got a spot?
launcher.lead: Online booking inside Telegram. Choose a business and the client app opens.

unsupported.title: Open the app in Telegram
unsupported.description: Booking works inside Telegram: open the app with the menu button in the {{brand}} bot's chat.

emulator.hint: This is how the app looks in Telegram. Telegram itself draws the bottom button and Back.

business.notFoundDescription: The link may be outdated. Open the app from the business's chat again.
business.missingDescription: Open the app from the business's link.

services.title: Choose services
services.emptyDescription: This location has no services for online booking. Try another location.
services.incompatible: Can't be combined with your choice: different specialists do them
services.notTogether: Not done together with your choice

staff.noTime: No openings in the next two weeks
staff.emptyTitle: No one can do these services together
staff.emptyDescription: Book them separately or choose others.

confirm.title: Review your booking
confirm.name: Name
confirm.nameRequired: Tell us what to call you
confirm.phoneHint: We'll send a reminder and let you know if anything changes
confirm.phoneInvalid: Check the number: some digits are missing or there are extra characters
confirm.slotTakenDescription: Choose another one: the schedule is already up to date.
confirm.assignedFallback: If this time gets taken first, we'll find another specialist at no higher price.
confirm.priceRange: Specialists free at this time charge {{range}}.

rule.balanced: We assign whoever has fewer bookings that day.
rule.first_listed: We assign the first one free, in the business's order.

confirm.goneDescription: Choose another one: the schedule is up to date.
confirm.priceChangedDescription: Check the new amount and confirm your booking again.
confirm.depositHint: The rest, {{rest}}, is paid at the venue

summary.title: Your booking
summary.nothingYet: Choose services and your booking shows up here

bookings.title: My bookings
bookings.emptyUpcomingDescription: We'll find you a spot in a minute.
bookings.emptyPastTitle: Past visits will show up here
bookings.emptyPastDescription: Your history starts with your first visit.

booking.title: Booking
booking.notFoundDescription: It may have been made from another account.
booking.deadline: You can reschedule or cancel online until {{when}}.
booking.changesClosed: Online rescheduling and cancellation close {{duration}} before the visit. If your plans have changed, contact the business.
booking.cancelConsequence: The time will be freed up for other clients to book.

crash.title: Something went wrong
crash.description: Restart the screen: your chosen services and time will be kept.

reschedule.title: Reschedule booking
reschedule.sameTerms: Same specialist and services, and the price won't go up.
reschedule.closedDescription: Online changes for this booking are closed.

waitlist.title: Waitlist
waitlist.lead: We'll message you in Telegram if a time opens up on {{date}}.
waitlist.joinedDescription: We'll let you know when a time opens up

notifications.title: Reminders in Telegram
notifications.description: The bot will remind you of your visit and let you know when a time opens up.

payment.awaiting: We're holding the time until {{time}}. Once you pay {{amount}}, your booking is confirmed; the rest, {{rest}}, is paid at the venue.
payment.late: The payment hasn't come through yet. If you've already paid, your booking will be confirmed automatically and you'll get a notification. We're holding the time until {{time}}.
payment.declinedDescription: The time has been released for others. You can book again if it's still free.
payment.outside: The payment page opened in your browser. As soon as the payment goes through, your booking is confirmed automatically. We're holding the time until {{time}}.

offer.title: A time opened up and it's yours until {{time}}
offer.lead: Confirm and we'll book you. If it doesn't work, we'll offer this time to the next person in line.
offer.leadWithDeposit: Confirm and pay the {{amount}} deposit to secure your booking. If it doesn't work, we'll offer this time to the next person in line.
offer.declined: The time went to the next person in line
